title: Construct KnowledgeStore Capability Declaration
description: A deployment's declared knowledge-storage capability across six axes (metadataStore, keywordSearch, vectorSearch, embedding, reranking, sharedStorage), tagged with one of four named modes (minimal-local, capable-local-semantic, team, remote-where-justified). Reference shape for lib/engine/knowledge-store-contract.mjs (construct-tsyfe.7.1) — hand-validated there, not by this file directly (ADR-0001: no external schema-validation library in core).

justification.description: Required non-empty when mode is remote-where-justified, or when any axis declares remote:true — documents why a remote-hosted backend is warranted (Security & privacy: audits which backend processes document content off-machine).

providerId.description: Required non-empty when present is true — identifies which module/service satisfies this axis (e.g. lib/storage/vector-client.mjs).

remote.description: True when the provider runs off the local machine (e.g. a hosted embedding API) — forces justification to be declared.
